theory: The stated digit ranges and noon/midnight facts are correct, but the steps stop at identifying digit parts and broad parts of day. They do not teach the booklet's assessed task of converting between 12-hour and 24-hour time, including subtracting 12 for hours 13–23 and handling midnight and noon; align the procedure with that source method when repairing the off-booklet items.
summary: Replaced the fifteen off-booklet practice items and five flagged quiz questions with cited conversion questions using new values, updated their structure slugs, and preserved quiz.q3 exactly. Changed the theory steps to teach both conversion directions and the midnight and noon exceptions; no whole items were removed.
reviewSummary: All 21 items have correct answers, usable working and booklet-supported conversion tasks, including identifying the 24-hour representation of noon; every quiz has exactly one correct option and specific, consistent distractor explanations. The theory correctly handles midnight and noon, all tier minimums are met, and no worked examples or removals were supplied.
